summary.title: Stage summary
about.title: About this map
about.p1: This map shows the bike route across Eurasia, using OpenStreetMap as a base, a periodically updated track and end-of-day points calculated from GPS data.
about.p2: The statistics (days cycled, total kilometres, elevation gain, average speed) are generated by a script that processes the files recorded in the field and produces a GeoJSON for the track, a daily summary and a list of geotagged photos.
about.p3: The source code of this project is available on GitHub, together with the scripts that prepare the data and the workflow used to update the map automatically.
